title_he: אַשְׁרֵי מִי שֶׁשָּׁכַב בַּאדֹנָי יֵשׁוּעַ הַמָּשִׁיחַ
review: The hymn is the Christian funeral hope: 1:1–4 is Rev 14:13 (אַשְׁרֵי הַמֵּתִים … בַּאֲדֹנָי) with Isa 57:1–2, 2:1–4 is 1 Thess 4:13 (לֹא כַּנִּשְׁאָרִים) nearly verbatim, 3:1–4 is 1 Cor 15:20 (בִּכּוּרִים) with Phil 3:21, 4:1–4 is 1 Thess 4:16–17, 5:1–4 is 1 John 3:2, and 6:1–4 is Rev 22:20 with Ps 84:7.

6:2 עֵמֶק הַדְּמָעוֹת uses the psalm's valley-of-weeping phrase (Ps 84:7), chosen for the Arabic وَادِي الدُّمُوع because the stanza is the funeral comfort and the psalm's phrase is the one the church uses at the grave.

1:3 מִפְּנֵי הָרַע אֲסָפוֹ — the Arabic مِنْ وَجْهِ الشَّرِّ ضَمَّهُ is 'gathered him from the face of evil'; the Hebrew uses אָסַף, the verb of Gen 25:8 and 2 Kgs 22:20 for being gathered to one's fathers, so the line is the peaceful death and not merely a rescue.
